name: Differentiable Volumetric Path Tracing
aliases: Differentiable Volumetric Path Tracing for Albedo Gradient
Differentiable Volumetric Path Tracing with Albedo Gradient
Differential Theory of Radiative Transfer / Differentiable Volumetric Path Tracing
unbiased Monte Carlo method for scene derivatives
definition: An unbiased Monte Carlo method analogous to volumetric path tracing (VPT) used to numerically estimate derivatives of the radiative transfer equation (RTE) with respect to arbitrary scene parameterizations.
summary: Differentiable Volumetric Path Tracing is an unbiased Monte Carlo method that simultaneously estimates radiance and its gradient with respect to scene parameters like albedo, enabling inverse rendering optimization in participating media.
